purpose: Teach: 差益/守秘/ターボ/コストダウン/返上/行革/株券/引渡し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、為替差益で苦労されたぞ
lines.en: Your grandfather struggled with foreign exchange gains when we were starting out.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reflection. Slight pause before speaking, as if reaching back through decades. Gentle authority in the voice — not lecturing, remembering aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に守秘の徹底を求められた
lines.en: Yes. He demanded absolute confidentiality from the staff.
lines.style: Respectful, almost formal. A slight nod in the voice. Clear and steady — acknowledging what was asked of him without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新事業をターボで進められたぞ
lines.en: Your grandfather pushed the new business forward at full speed.
lines.style: Tone of quiet admiration mixed with slight wistfulness. Slower pace on 'pushed forward' — savoring the memory of that momentum and urgency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはコストダウン案を自ら考えられた
lines.en: Yes. He came up with the cost-cutting ideas himself.
lines.style: Steady, grounded delivery. A note of pride underlying the simplicity. Eyes-forward kind of voice — factual but warm with recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、不要な役職を自ら返上されたぞ
lines.en: Your grandfather gave up unnecessary positions of his own accord.
lines.style: Soft admiration in the tone. Slight trailing-off on the last phrase — letting the weight of that choice settle. Genuinely moved by the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社内行革を断行された
lines.en: Yes. He personally oversaw every single product handover to customers.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Emphasis lands firmly on 'personally' and 'every single' — not rushed, deliberate. The voice of someone who understands the principle behind the practice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、株券を社員に配ろうとされたぞ
lines.en: Your grandfather wanted to distribute shares to his staff.
lines.style: Wondering tone — the voice of someone recalling a moment of clear generosity and idealism. Slight lift at 'distribute shares,' then a soft fadeout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品引渡し時に必ず立ち会われた
lines.en: Yes. He made certain he was present at every product delivery to customers.
lines.style: Final, settled voice. Quiet authority with deep warmth underneath. The closing reflection of someone who has understood, over decades, what his father's choices meant.
